title: Elon Musk now INVOLVED in the rise of vibe-coded SLOTBOUND
author: dedaistgeil
selftext:
Follow-up Post to [my recent one](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1y1021y/good_vibecoded_game_made_1_million_within_the/) about Slotbound. The game made more than $1 million in the first week after launch, currently this amount should easily be doubled.

The Rise continues, the game doesn't seem to stop getting traction. Though the playercount seems to slowly decline/stabilize, which is absolutely normal after launch.

Anyways today something unreal happened to our saviour OptimaArch that I want to share with you guys.

**Elon Musk himself reposted a post about** [**Slotbound**](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4459590/Slotbound/)**.**

Just imagine making your first game with AI, seeing all those numbers, making so much money and then you wake up, scroll trough X (Twitter) and see Elon Musk reposting about your game.

This guy must feel like he is in a never ending dream. 

Huge props to him for achieving so much with his first game. 

Some of you call it luck and I also think it is luck BUT keep in mind:

**We all rely on luck, the only thing we can do is to increase our changes of becoming lucky.** 

It is easy to call someone out for just being lucky, but there was a long process in which he slowly increased his chances that ended up paying off.

If you make AI slop there is basically zero chance for you, if you make a good game and do the usual marketing stuff you can end up having a quite big chance.
